1.

Father in the glory, We behold Thy beloved Son, Exalted at Thy right hand, Richly rewarded for the earth’s scorn.

2.

On Thy throne, O God, our Father, He who as man is seated crowned, He who bore the crown of thorns And here endured reproach.

3.

Him the angels admire, He who fulfilled Thy will here, Every tongue shall confess: Jesus is Lord of all.

4.

God and Father, our hearts Bring Thee the sacrifice of praise For Thy Son, whom Thou hast given. Praise be to Thee eternally!
